_about: Internal. Never delivered. What each tag shows in the scenario and how old tag and asset names map onto scada_tags.json v2.

tag_events.GW.SUB1.BUS.VOLT.PV: Primary 345-kV import point. Relay 27-UV trip threshold raised from 0.88 pu to 0.94 pu by adversary at GW-EVT-003 (D-3 17:04Z). This caused premature undervoltage trip during Hurricane Rafael voltage sag (GW-EVT-004 D0). REL_UV_THR.SP is a primary attack-signature tag.
tag_events.GW.SUB1.BUS.VOLT.SP: Setpoint written by SCADA or EMS AGC.
tag_events.GW.SUB1.BKR1.STATUS.STS: Trips D0 07:12Z on the altered 27-UV threshold (GW-EVT-004).
tag_events.GW.SUB1.REL.UV_THR.SP: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Adversary raised this setpoint from 0.88 pu to 0.94 pu at D-3 17:04Z (GW-EVT-003). Normal value is 0.88 pu. Any value above 0.90 pu is anomalous and indicates relay manipulation. This is a primary forensic artifact.
tag_events.GW.SUB1.REL.CFG_HASH.PV: CRC32 of active relay config file. Used for config-tamper detection.
tag_events.GW.SUB2.BUS.VOLT.PV: 138/69 kV step-down. Adversary sent breaker-open command at GW-EVT-005 (D+7), tripping Harbor Bridge and port distribution feeders. BKR1.STS and BUS_VOLT.PV will show anomalous values at D+7.
tag_events.GW.SUB2.BUS.VOLT.SP: Setpoint written by SCADA or EMS AGC.
tag_events.GW.SUB2.BKR1.STATUS.STS: Opened by command D+7 14:28Z (GW-EVT-005); closed again D+35.
tag_events.GW.SUB2.REL.UV_THR.SP: Relay configuration modified as part of same attack chain (GW-EVT-003/010). Verify against pre-storm baseline of 0.88 pu.
tag_events.GW.SUB2.REL.CFG_HASH.PV: CRC32 of active relay config file. Used for config-tamper detection.
tag_events.GW.SUB3.BUS.VOLT.PV: 138/69 kV step-down. Second adversary breaker-open at GW-EVT-007 (D+10), tripping 6,800 customers. BKR1.STS drops to 0 (open) during attack.
tag_events.GW.SUB3.BUS.VOLT.SP: Setpoint written by SCADA or EMS AGC.
tag_events.GW.SUB3.BKR1.STATUS.STS: Opened by command D+10 19:43Z (GW-EVT-007); closed again D+35.
tag_events.GW.SUB3.REL.UV_THR.SP: Relay configuration modified as part of same attack chain (GW-EVT-003/010). Verify against pre-storm baseline of 0.88 pu.
tag_events.GW.SUB3.REL.CFG_HASH.PV: CRC32 of active relay config file. Used for config-tamper detection.
tag_events.GW.SUB4.BUS.VOLT.SP: Setpoint written by SCADA or EMS AGC.
tag_events.GW.SUB4.REL.UV_THR.SP: Relay configuration modified as part of same attack chain (GW-EVT-003/010). Verify against pre-storm baseline of 0.88 pu.
tag_events.GW.SUB4.REL.CFG_HASH.PV: CRC32 of active relay config file. Mismatch versus historian baseline indicates unauthorized config change. SUB-04 checksum mismatch discovered D+16 (GW-EVT-010).
tag_events.GW.SUB5.BUS.VOLT.SP: Setpoint written by SCADA or EMS AGC.
tag_events.GW.SUB5.REL.CFG_HASH.PV: CRC32 of active relay config file. Used for config-tamper detection.
tag_events.GW.GEN1.UNIT1.MW.PV: Gas turbine peaking unit. Dispatched during storm restoration at D+1. Cannot compensate for relay trips at SUB-01 alone.
tag_events.GW.GEN1.UNIT1.FREQ.PV: Frequency deviations during relay trips visible at D0 and D+7.
tag_events.GW.WTR1.PUMP1.FLOW.PV: Lifts raw water from Lake Texana into Mary Rhodes Phase I pipeline. Not on primary CBPWA SCADA but feeds FAC-UTL-01 raw water supply.
tag_events.GW.WTR2.PUMP1.FLOW.PV: Mid-route booster, Mary Rhodes Phase I. Manual backup if SCADA unavailable.
tag_events.GW.WTR3.PUMP1.FLOW.PV: Phase II booster. ATTACK SIGNATURE: Historian records unauthorized setpoint changes on D+23 (GW-EVT-013). PRESS.SP and FLOW.SP tags show anomalous writes outside authorized change windows. This is a primary CISA forensic artifact.
tag_events.GW.WTR3.PUMP1.PRESS.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE (WTR3): Unauthorized setpoint push observed D+23 (GW-EVT-013).
tag_events.GW.WTR3.PUMP1.PRESS.SP: ATTACK SIGNATURE (WTR3): Historian records unauthorized write to this tag at D+23 (GW-EVT-013). Value changed outside authorized change window. CISA forensic artifact.
tag_events.GW.WTR3.PUMP2.PRESS.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE (WTR3): Unauthorized setpoint push observed D+23 (GW-EVT-013).
tag_events.GW.WTR3.PUMP2.PRESS.SP: ATTACK SIGNATURE (WTR3): Historian records unauthorized write to this tag at D+23 (GW-EVT-013). Value changed outside authorized change window. CISA forensic artifact.
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PLANT.FLOW.PV: Nominal capacity 75 MGD. Degradation expected at D+9 when Pump P-3 setpoint lowered (GW-EVT-006).
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PUMP1.FLOW.PV: Lead pump. Normal operation throughout scenario.
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PUMP2.FLOW.PV: Lag pump 1. Normal operation throughout scenario.
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PUMP3.FLOW.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Adversary lowered discharge pressure setpoint from 85 psi to 68 psi at D+9 (GW-EVT-006) via SCADA. PRESS.SP shows unauthorized write. Reduced system pressure led to distribution pressure drop detected at D+10 (GW-EVT-008). Key forensic tags: PRESS.SP, PRESS.PV.
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PUMP3.PRESS.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Drops to ~68 psi range at D+9 as result of setpoint manipulation (GW-EVT-006).
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PUMP3.PRESS.SP: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Adversary wrote 68 psi to this tag at D+9 (GW-EVT-006). Normal/baseline value 85 psi. This unauthorized setpoint reduction is the primary mechanism for the distribution pressure drop reported by field operator at D+10 (GW-EVT-008). Primary forensic artifact.
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PUMP4.FLOW.PV: Standby pump. Brought online during restoration at D+42 (GW-EVT-016).
tag_events.GW.UTL1.PUMP4.RUN.STS: Value=0 (stopped) for P4 until restoration at D+42 (GW-EVT-016).
tag_events.GW.TK01.LEVEL.PV: First to drop below 50% at D+10 due to pump pressure reduction (GW-EVT-006/008). Level.PV and LEVEL_PCT.PV are attack-signature tags — anomalous declining trend starting D+9.
tag_events.GW.TK01.LEVEL_PCT.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: First tank to breach 50% threshold at D+10 (GW-EVT-008).
tag_events.GW.TK01.FILL_VALVE.SP: 0=fully closed, 100=fully open. Modulated by level controller.

tag_events.GW.RTU1.SCAN_AGE.PV: Time since last successful SCADA poll. High value indicates comms fault or deliberate disconnect.
tag_events.GW.RTU1.CFG_HASH.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Relay 27-UV threshold written to 0.94 pu at D-3 17:04Z (GW-EVT-003). COMMS.STS and SCAN_AGE.PV may show brief disruption during malicious config push. CFG_HASH.PV will not match pre-attack baseline. Mismatch vs. historian baseline at CRC snapshot confirms tamper.

tag_events.GW.SCADA.SERVER.COMMS.STS: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Alarm suppression list extended at D-3 17:09Z (GW-EVT-003). Active alarm suppression may mask malicious activity even when COMMS.STS is healthy.
tag_events.GW.SCADA.ALARM_SUPR_CNT.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Count rises from baseline (~35) to 40 at D-3 17:09Z when adversary adds relay trip alarms for SUB-01 through SUB-04 to suppression list (GW-EVT-003). Elevated suppression count is a key pre-attack indicator.
tag_events.GW.SCADA.ACTIVE_ALARMS.PV: Storm-window alert flood visible D-2 through D+3 (GW-EVT-104).
tag_events.GW.SCADA.SETPOINT_WRITES.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Spike at D+9 when adversary writes pump pressure setpoints (GW-EVT-006). Historian records unauthorized write burst outside authorized change window. Used in GW-EVT-013 forensic analysis.
tag_events.GW.HST.SERVER.COMMS.STS: Historian stores all tag values and alarm events. Session logs capture 14 adversary access sessions D-7 to D+16 (GW-EVT-002/011).
tag_events.GW.HST.WRITE_RATE.PV: Storm window spike expected D-2 to D+3 as 73,785 alerts flood Sentinel Edge (GW-EVT-104).
tag_events.GW.HST.SESSION_CNT.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: After-hours session count anomalies detected in D-7 through D+16 period (GW-EVT-002, GW-EVT-011/106). 14 authenticated adversary sessions under stolen credentials.
tag_events.GW.HST.AFTER_HRS_ACCESS.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Non-zero after 00:00-04:00Z window outside maintenance exception. Adversary sessions at D-7 02:44Z (GW-EVT-102) and subsequent nights show non-zero counts. Suppressed by MAINT-EXCEPT-0892 rule during attack period.
tag_events.GW.JMP.ACTIVE_SESSIONS.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: 14 authenticated adversary sessions from non-Texas IP blocks (185.220.x.x — Tor exit nodes) between D-7 and D+28 (GW-EVT-002/011). Normal business-hours sessions from authorized IP blocks; off-hours sessions should be zero outside scheduled maintenance.
tag_events.GW.JMP.AUTH_FAILURES.PV: Credential stuffing or brute force indicator. No anomaly during main attack (stolen valid credentials used).
tag_events.GW.JMP.SRC_IP_GEO.PV: ATTACK SIGNATURE: Risk score spikes to 90+ during adversary sessions from Central European ISP / Tor exit nodes. Normal CBPWA engineer sessions from Texas ISPs score <15.
